ISLAMIC MEASURES OTHER THAN ZAKAT TO SATISFY WANTS There are more wealth rights which are obligatory for the Muslims under various conditions. These are in addition to the Poor-due, and are Rights of Neighbour : God has commanded in the Holy Qur’4n to look after the rights of the neighbour. The Holy Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) has persuaded the Muslims to fulfil the rights of the neighbour, and is contained in the Traditions. To care for the rights of the neighbour is one of the essentials of Faith, and it is forbidden to harm him or ignore his rights, as ‘*...Ascribe no thing as partner unto Him. (Show) kindness unto parents, and unto near
